label: Active farms
what: Farms that saved at least one entry in the 7 days ending on the last day chosen.
why: Shows how many farms really use the app each week, not just how many signed up.

label: Installs
what: People who installed the app from Google Play in the chosen days.
why: Shows how many people the marketing reaches before they ever sign up.

label: Sign-ups
what: People who verified their phone number with the SMS code in the chosen days.
why: Shows how many new people actually start using the app, day by day.

label: Daily active people
what: People with at least one entry that reached the server on the last day chosen.
why: Shows for how many people the app is part of their working day.

label: Weekly active people
what: People who saved at least one entry in the last 7 days.
why: Shows the steady base of people using the app every week.

label: Monthly active people
what: People who saved at least one entry in the last 30 days.
why: Shows the widest group still using the app, the base for every habit figure.

label: Stickiness
what: Daily active people as a share of monthly active people.
why: Shows whether people active in the month come back daily; higher means a real daily habit.

label: Entries saved
what: Every diary entry saved on the server in the chosen days.
why: Shows the total work being recorded, the plainest sign the app is used.

label: Saved by voice
what: Share of saved entries that came from a voice recording the app understood and checked.
why: Shows whether speaking, the app's main promise, is really how farmers record their work.

label: मला किती समजलं
what: The middle score out of 10 across scored farm-days, including days scored 0 the phone hides.
why: Shows whether farmers' words are understood well enough to trust the record.

label: Crash-free sessions
what: Share of app openings that ended without the app crashing.
why: Shows whether the app is stable enough on farmers' phones to rely on.

label: Installs and sign-ups
what: Installs and sign-ups for each day, drawn as two lines.
why: Shows how many installers go on to verify their phone, and on which days.

label: Entries saved, voice and typed
what: Entries saved each week, split into voice entries and typed entries.
why: Shows whether voice use is growing or shrinking week by week.

label: Headline
what: One sentence joining active farms, voice share and entries saved.
why: Gives the state of the company in one line before reading any tile.

label: Installed the app
what: People who installed the app, the first step before signing up.
why: Starting point for seeing how many installers become real users.

label: Verified phone by OTP
what: People who verified their phone with the SMS code in the chosen days.
why: Second step: shows how many people who arrive actually sign up.

label: Set up or joined a farm
what: Of those sign-ups, people who created a farm or joined someone's farm.
why: Shows whether new people get past setup, where many apps lose people.

label: Saved a first entry
what: Of those sign-ups, people with at least one entry that reached the server.
why: Shows whether new people do the one thing the app is for.

label: Saved entries on 3 of their first 7 days
what: Sign-ups old enough to judge who had entries reach the server on 3 of their first 7 days.
why: Shows whether new people form a habit early, the best sign they will stay.

label: Installs per day
what: Installs from Google Play counted for each day.
why: Shows which days campaigns or demos brought people in.

label: Installs by channel
what: Installs split by where they came from, such as Google Play search, WhatsApp, producer organisation or demo.
why: Shows which way of reaching farmers brings the most people, so effort goes there.

label: Phone verified, by channel
what: For each source of installs, the share who verified their phone.
why: Shows which source brings people who actually sign up, not just install.

label: Habit, by channel
what: For each install source, the share with entries reaching the server on 3 of their first 7 days.
why: Shows which source brings farmers who keep using the app.

label: Installs by district
what: Installs counted by the district where the phone was.
why: Shows where the app is spreading and where field effort is needed.

label: Headline
what: One sentence joining sign-ups, the early habit share, installs and channels.
why: Gives the state of new-farmer growth in one line.

label: Entries by type
what: Saved entries by kind, as the app's own work-word list reads them; one entry can count twice.
why: Shows what farmers use the app for, and which kinds of work go unrecorded.

label: Entries per active farm, per week
what: Entries saved in the last 7 days divided by farms active in those 7 days.
why: Shows how deeply an active farm uses the app, not just whether it does.

label: When farmers log
what: Entries by hour of day and day of week, India time, when they reached the server.
why: Shows when farmers work with the app, to time reminders, support and updates.

label: Feature use
what: Of people who did anything counted here this period, the share using each part; Compare is not recorded.
why: Shows which features earn their place and which nobody uses.

label: Monthly active people by role
what: People who saved an entry in the last 30 days, split by their role on the farm.
why: Shows whether only owners use the app, or their workers and supervisors too.

label: Feature use by role
what: People who used each part of the app, split by their role on the farm.
why: Shows which features matter to owners and which to workers or supervisors.

label: Headline
what: One sentence joining entries per active farm and the busiest hour.
why: Gives in one line how deeply farms use the app.

label: Came back next day
what: Share of new sign-ups with an entry reaching the server on the day after they signed up.
why: Shows whether the first day convinced people to return.

label: Active on day 30
what: Share of sign-ups with an entry reaching the server on the thirtieth day after signing up.
why: Shows whether the app becomes a lasting habit, not a one-time try.

label: Silent 7–29 days
what: Farms whose last entry was 7 to 29 days ago.
why: These farms can still be won back with a call; it sizes today's call list.

label: Silent 30+ days
what: Farms whose last entry was 30 or more days ago.
why: Shows how many farms have stopped; a rising number means the app is losing farmers.

label: Return by sign-up week
what: For each week's sign-ups, the share with an entry reaching the server on day 1, 7, 14, 30.
why: Shows whether newer groups of farmers stay longer than older ones after each change.

label: Return curve
what: Share of sign-ups with an entry reaching the server each day after signing up, up to day 30.
why: Shows on which day people drop off, and whether that is getting better.

label: Where every registered farm stands
what: Every registered farm placed by days since its last entry, including farms that never saved one.
why: Shows the whole farm base at a glance: active, going quiet, stopped, never started.

label: Where farms are going quiet
what: Farms silent 7 to 29 days, counted by district.
why: Shows which areas need a field visit or a local partner's help.

label: Farms that can still be won back
what: Farms silent 7 to 29 days, counted for each day of the range.
why: Shows whether the call list is growing or shrinking over time.

label: Headline
what: One sentence joining next-day return, day-30 return and farms going quiet.
why: Gives in one line whether farmers stay.

label: Voice recordings saved
what: Share of voice recordings that became a saved entry.
why: Shows whether speaking actually ends in a saved record or gets lost.

label: Speech service time
what: Average time the speech service took to turn a recording into words.
why: Shows whether farmers are kept waiting after they speak.

label: Slowest 5%
what: The longest wait for 95 of every 100 recordings; only the slowest 5 waited longer.
why: Shows the worst waits farmers commonly face, which an average hides.

label: Entries corrected
what: Share of saved entries changed by the farmer after saving.
why: Shows how often the first saved record was wrong and needed fixing.

label: Sync failures
what: Of changes sent from phones, the share the server refused; a change refused again counts each time.
why: Shows whether farmers' entries reach the server reliably or get stuck on the phone.

label: Crash-free sessions
what: Share of app openings that ended without a crash.
why: Shows app stability, a top reason people give up on an app.

label: मला किती समजलं, score spread
what: How farm days spread across understanding scores from 0 to 10.
why: Shows whether poor understanding is rare or common, beyond the middle score.

label: Sync failures
what: Changes from phones the server refused or accepted, day by day.
why: Shows when upload problems started, to link them to a release or outage.

label: Crashes by app version
what: Crashes counted for each version of the app.
why: Shows whether a new release made the app less stable.

label: App version adoption
what: People seen in this period, each counted once on the version they used last; Android app apart.
why: Shows how many farmers still run an old version that lacks fixes.

label: Headline
what: One sentence joining voice recordings saved and entries corrected.
why: Gives in one line whether voice recording works for farmers.

label: Active farms
what: Farms that saved at least one entry in the last 7 days.
why: Shows the real size of the business: the farms that use it weekly.

label: Farms registered
what: All farms set up in the app by the last day chosen.
why: Shows total reach; next to active farms it shows how many went unused.

label: Acres covered
what: Acres of plots on farms that saved an entry in the last 7 days.
why: Shows how much farmland the app really covers, a figure partners and funders ask for.

label: Farms in a producer organisation
what: Share of active farms that belong to a farmer producer organisation.
why: Shows how much growth comes through producer organisations rather than one farmer at a time.

label: Active farms by district
what: Active farms counted by district and taluka.
why: Shows where the app is used, to plan field teams and partners.

label: Crops on active farms
what: Crops on active farms by the name entered, with farms and plot acres; a plot can count twice.
why: Shows which crops the app serves, to shape schedules and partnerships.

label: Farms per producer organisation
what: Farms counted under each farmer producer organisation.
why: Shows which organisations bring the most farms and which need support.

label: Acres covered
what: Acres under active farms, measured each week across the range.
why: Shows whether the land covered is growing or shrinking.

label: Headline
what: One sentence joining active farms, acres covered and the top district.
why: Gives the farm footprint in one line.

label: OTP delivered
what: Share of sign-in SMS codes that actually reached the phone.
why: Shows whether farmers can sign in at all; a code that never arrives loses a farmer.

label: OTP arrival time
what: Average seconds for a sign-in SMS code to reach the phone.
why: Shows whether farmers wait too long at sign-in and give up.

label: OTP texts delivered
what: Sign-in SMS codes sent and delivered, day by day.
why: Shows when SMS delivery broke, to raise it with the SMS provider.

label: Why OTP texts failed
what: Sign-in SMS codes that failed, grouped by the reason the SMS provider gave.
why: Shows what to fix with the SMS provider, such as blocked numbers or network faults.

label: Tickets opened
what: New help requests from farmers in the chosen days.
why: Shows how much trouble farmers run into.

label: Tickets closed
what: Help requests solved in the chosen days.
why: Shows whether the support team keeps up with requests.

label: Open tickets
what: Help requests still waiting on the last day chosen.
why: Shows the backlog of farmers waiting for help.

label: Time to close
what: Average hours from a help request to its solution.
why: Shows how long a stuck farmer waits for help.

label: Support tickets opened and closed
what: Help requests opened and closed, day by day.
why: Shows whether support is falling behind, and when.

label: Top issues farmers raised
what: The most common problems farmers raised in help requests.
why: Shows what to fix first in the app or in training.

label: Headline
what: One sentence on sign-in SMS delivery and farmer help requests.
why: Gives in one line whether farmers can sign in and get help.

label: Alert rules
what: Two automatic checks: over 30 server errors in an hour, and voice failing over 20% in six hours.
why: Raises a flag when something breaks for many farmers at once.

label: Recent events
what: Every server error, slow save and phone-reported problem in the last two hours, test phones included.
why: Shows what is breaking right now, before farmers call to complain.

label: Feeds this console depends on
what: Whether each data source behind this screen answered, and when it was last heard.
why: Tells you whether the numbers on the screen can be trusted right now.

label: API errors
what: Each server error, slow save and phone-reported problem, with its time, place and status.
why: Lets you see exactly what failed and when, so it gets fixed.

label: Errors in the chosen window
what: Number of errors, slow saves and phone-reported problems in the chosen time window, test phones included.
why: Shows whether problems are rising or falling across hours and days.

label: Farm
what: The farm each error belongs to, when the request named a farm.
why: Shows which farmers were hit by a problem, so someone can call them.

label: Checked farm-days per farm
what: Average days per farm last week with an entry checked by a person within 48 hours.
why: Shows whether farms record confirmed work most days, the old main company target.

label: Change from the week before
what: Change in that average from the week before.
why: Shows whether confirmed daily use is improving or slipping.

label: Farms with a row that week
what: Farms that saved at least one entry in that week.
why: Shows how many farms the weekly average is worked out over.

label: Tiers among the farms this feed returns
what: Farms grouped A to D by how many checked days they had last week.
why: Shows how many farms are steady users and how many barely use the app.

label: Every farm's contribution
what: Each farm's checked days last week, with self-confirmed days shown apart.
why: Shows which farms lead and which need attention.

label: All farms
what: Every farm with its name, the owner's phone and the date it was set up.
why: Lets you find and call any farm directly.

label: Total farms
what: Number of farms set up in the app, with no activity filter.
why: Shows how many farms you can reach from this list.

label: Last Log
what: When each farm's latest entry reached the server.
why: Shows which farms have gone quiet, so someone can call them.

label: Tier
what: Each farm's A to D group by checked days last week.
why: Lets you sort farms into steady, light and absent users.

label: Checked days last week
what: Each farm's days last week with an entry checked by a person.
why: Shows how regularly each farm records its work.

label: Errors 24h
what: Problems in the last 24 hours on requests that named this farm.
why: Shows which farmers are struggling with the app today.

label: Farmer suffering watchlist
what: Farms with three or more problems in 7 days on requests that named the farm.
why: Names the farmers most likely to give up, so someone helps them first.

label: 14-day timeline (started, finished, proof, summary viewed)
what: For one farm, each day's day-closings started and finished, proof photos added and summaries viewed.
why: Shows how one farm really uses the app, day by day, before you call.

label: Errors
what: Problems on requests that named this farm, on each of the last 14 days.
why: Shows whether a farm went quiet after a run of failures.

label: Last entry reached the server
what: When this farm's latest entry reached the server.
why: Shows how long this farm has been quiet.

label: Accounts
what: Every person with an account: phone, name and the date they joined.
why: Lets you find any person and check their account.

label: Total accounts
what: Number of accounts, test accounts included.
why: Shows how many people have ever signed up, before test accounts are taken out.

label: Last sign-in
what: When each person last signed in, or the app last renewed their sign-in.
why: Shows whether a person still opens the app, even without saving entries.

label: Schedule templates
what: The ready-made crop schedules farmers can pick, with crop, tasks and timing.
why: Shows which crops have a schedule ready and which still need one.

label: Monthly revenue
what: Money that paying farms bring in each month.
why: Shows whether paying farms cover the cost of running ShramSafal each month.

label: Farms a person should call today
what: Farms gone quiet or hitting repeated problems, named with the owner's phone number.
why: Gives the team a short list of farmers to call before they give up.

label: Farms with repeated problems, last 24 hours
what: Farms with two or more problems in the last day on requests that named the farm.
why: Lets the team call a farmer the same day things go wrong.

label: Weeks with a row
what: Weeks in the chosen time with at least one farm saving an entry.
why: Tells you how much history the averages above are built on.

label: Goal
what: The weekly confirmed farm-days per farm the company aims for.
why: A target turns the number into a plain yes or no for each week.

label: Farms gone silent
what: Farms with no entry for a week or more, with owner phone and last entry.
why: Names the farms to call back before they stop using the app for good.

label: Plan
what: Whether the farm's owner is on the free plan, a trial or a paid plan.
why: Helps decide who to call first when a paying farm goes quiet.

label: By silence and by plan
what: Counts of silent farms grouped by days silent and by plan.
why: Shows at a glance whether quiet farms are new trials or paying farms.

label: Syncing, entries and voice columns
what: Splits each farm's problems into syncing, saving entries, voice recording and other.
why: Tells the team which part of the app to look at before calling.

label: Farms to help first
what: Farms whose health score dropped the most, with the score and last active day.
why: Points the team to farms slipping before they go silent.

label: Score spread
what: How many farms fall in each band of the farm health score.
why: Shows whether most farms are doing well or struggling overall.

label: Where farms lose points
what: Which of the six parts of the health score pulls farms down the most.
why: Tells the product team what to improve first for most farms.

label: Average score by week
what: The average farm health score across all farms, week by week.
why: Shows whether farms are getting healthier over time or slipping.

label: Farmer name and phone
what: The farm owner's name and phone number.
why: So the team can call the right person straight from this page.

label: Farm score and its six parts
what: This farm's health score and the six parts it is made of.
why: Shows what this one farm does well and where it needs help.

label: Checked
what: Entries on this farm checked by a person on purpose, counted once per entry each day.
why: Shows whether the farm's records are trusted, not only typed in.

label: Checks on entries
what: Entries confirmed, verified, disputed, waiting, or checked only by the person who saved them.
why: A pile of waiting or disputed entries is a reason to call.

label: Workers
what: The five workers named most often in this farm's entries.
why: Shows who actually does the work, so a call can mention them.

label: Refused uploads
what: Times the server refused entries sent from this farm's phone in the last 7 days.
why: Refused uploads mean the farmer's work may not have reached us.

label: Voice and photo reading
what: Share of this farm's voice recordings read and saved; photos are counted, not yet scored.
why: If reading fails often, the farmer stops trusting voice and photos.

label: Recordings and photos read
what: How many voice recordings and photos from this farm finished reading in 14 days, saved or not.
why: Shows how much this farm relies on voice and photos to keep records.
